prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: final landscape mobile native game screen design, RacingClub horse route puzzle.
Input images: Image 1 (original polished pastoral UI) is style/material reference only. Image 2 (current Android screenshot with huge green rotation circles) is structure/rules reference; redesign its operations, not those ugly circles.
Primary request: produce a concrete polished 16:9 screen at 1920x1080 style. Preserve the warm illustrated equestrian meadow, creamy center, timber top-down 5 by 4 board with letter entrances A–F, wood tiles and ivory tracks, colored numbered obstacles, horse at start. Left board uses almost entire available height (about 64% screen width). No header or task above board. Right area is open directly on the creamy scene background, NO large enclosing white rounded card, no panel border.
Composition: right upper area contains compact back button, Chinese '挑战 03', small '入门' chip, timer '00:12.36', small trophy and help icons. Under it show every goal simultaneously, E → 5 → 1 → 6 → F. Endpoint tiny arrow/checker clues; colored numbered badges with WHITE text on dark circles. Right middle contains ONLY three required tile cards sorted 1,5,6 (never an all-ten inventory entry), with 1 selected by refined forest green/gold keyline. The two counterclockwise/clockwise 90-degree rotation controls belong immediately BELOW the selected tile card as one small refined paired cream-and-bronze capsule with a subtle upward connector to that card; never on left board. Each half is a comfortable tactile rounded square with a carefully drawn thin forest-green curved arrow and tiny '90°' inscription inside the icon. A restrained warm wood lip, champagne highlight, fine bronze outline, subtle press depth, clean crisp recognizable icons, no huge solid green circles.
Right BOTTOM has exactly four independent square icon-only operation buttons in one aligned row: return selected tile to tray (tray with upward arrow), undo (single bent left arrow), hint (lightbulb), reset (circular refresh arrow). Redesign all controls as a coherent family: ivory ceramic/inset parchment faces, delicate bronze outline, subtle warm bevel, forest-green line icons; hint may have a small restrained amber accent. Back/trophy/help use the same family in smaller sizes. Never a trial-run/play/confirm button. No text labels for operations. Include selected tile and one additional tile on board, no rotation controls over board, no movement guide overlay.
Typography: elegant bold legible Chinese; generous natural tracking, not spaced-out characters. Text only exact labels named above, numerals, timer and letters. No title '拼板', no '已选中', no onboarding instructions, no inventory grid icon. The goal strip can have a subtle small cream band, individual tile cards may be lightly framed, but right region itself MUST be borderless and visually open. Design for eventual 10 required tiles in two rows; do not add decorative preview tiles to level lists. No device mockup, watermark, extraneous banners, or annotations. High visual craft, sharp readable button glyphs.
implementation: Native controls recreate the generated ceramic/bronze face and paired rotation popover; no screenshot used as an application UI.
